title: feat(app-shell): My views in the list view switcher: save, rename, delete and pin the reader's own views
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbHYXLHykShJcAMzTTjKDSLm)_

Fixes #29635

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：任何对象列表的视图切换器里新增「我的视图」分组，普通成员（不只是管理员）可以把当前列表的筛选、排序、分组、列顺序、隐藏列和行高另存为自己的视图，并可重命名、删除、设为自己的默认视图。
- **为什么改**：服务端的个人视图对象 `sys_personal_view` 已在 #29575 上线，但界面上还没有入口，成员只能每次手动重设列表条件。
- **风险与回滚**：只改界面，不动服务端；个人视图读取失败或被拒时分组和保存入口直接隐藏，列表照常显示。没有固定或指定个人视图时，列表首屏不等这次读取。回滚即还原此 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/personalViews.ts`（读写与保存体）和 `ObjectView.tsx` 里只在必要时等待读取的那一段。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:crm`，用普通成员登录，打开客户列表，按名称排序后点「另存为我的视图」，重命名、点 📌 设为默认、刷新页面确认打开的是它，再删除确认回到默认视图。
- **需要你做的**：审阅后合并；无需迁移或配置。

## What changes

- **My views.** `usePersonalViews` (new, `views/personalViews.ts`) reads the signed-in reader's own `sys_personal_view` rows through the data API (`find('sys_personal_view', { $filter: { object_name, user_id } })`) and keeps only the reader's rows of this object, because `admin_full_access` reads everyone's. The views join the switcher's list as a **My views** section, and each personal row offers rename, delete and the existing 📌.
- **Save as my view** sits at the end of the dropdown for any reader the server lets create a row, admin or not. It stores the open view's body with the list on screen laid over it: the address's filter, sort and grouping (`uf_*`), and the reader's column order, hidden columns and density. The body is a spec `ListView` with `data: { provider: 'object', object }`, built by the same `buildViewConfigSaveBody` the view config panel uses. A Filter panel group that cannot fold losslessly (nested) is refused with the panel's existing message instead of storing another record set. The saved view then opens.
- **Rename** is a data API `update` of `label`. **Delete** goes through the owner's door, `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/:id`, through app-shell's `createAuthenticatedFetch`, never the data API's delete. A failed write shows the server's message.
- **Set as my default** is the existing pin `LIST_PINNED_VIEW_PREFERENCE`. A personal view's id is in the view list, so `resolveViewId` resolves the pin on the next open. Deleting a pinned personal view clears the pin; a pin or address naming a view that is gone falls back to the default view with no error.
- **First paint.** While the read is out, the list waits only when the address or the pin names a view the list does not hold yet. Any other open paints the default view at once.
- **Refused read.** A reader whose read is refused (external members today) gets neither the section nor Save. The list is unaffected.
- i18n: three `view.switcher` keys (`myViews`, `saveAsMyView`, `myViewName`) in all ten locale packs. Docs: a "My views" bullet in `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`.

### Test doubles adjusted

Four existing ObjectView tests pin how many list queries the host sends. Their `dataSource.find` doubles counted every non-count `find`, so the new own-views read (`sys_personal_view`) moved their counts. In each, only the counter line changed: it now counts the list's own object (`object === OBJECT_NAME` / `object === OBJ`). No assertion changed. The seat approved this surface.

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.hostRerenderRefetch-10046.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.objectDocSwapNoRefetch-27626.test.tsx`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.stableFilterIdentity-7237.test.tsx`

## Tests

- `ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx` (9 cases, through the real `ObjectView` host and switcher, as a non-admin reader): own rows only; opening a personal view runs its filter; Save stores the sorted list as a `ListView` and opens it; Rename through `update`, Delete through the door with `dataSource.delete` never called; 📌 then a remount resolves the view; a deleted pinned view falls back; no pin plus a slow read paints the default view; a pinned view not yet held waits for the read; a refused read hides the section and Save.
- `personalViews.test.ts` (6 cases): row filtering, JSON-text config, entry shape, the save body parsed with spec's `ListViewSchema`, parts the address does not carry, and the nested-group refusal.

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each run with one test via `-t`; every one red on the intended assertion and restored to HEAD):

| # | Mutation | Test that went red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | row filter keeps every row | own rows only |
| A2 | save ignores the address's sort | Save stores the list on screen |
| A3 | rename writes `name` instead of `label` | Rename / Delete |
| A4 | delete goes to `/api/v1/data/sys_personal_view/:id` | Rename / Delete |
| A5 | the pin arm of the hold dropped | a pinned view waits for the read |
| A6 | the read counts as loading forever | a deleted pinned view falls back |
| A7 | every open waits for the read | no pin plus a slow read paints |
| A8 | a refused read reads as ready | a refused read hides Save |
| A9 | 📌 never writes the pin | 📌 is the reader's default |

## Acceptance notes

Live on `pnpm dev:crm --fresh` with the Console on Vite, as a plain member (`role: user`, not admin). A freshly created member reads no CRM object, so the admin gave them the CRM's own `sales_rep` position (a `sys_user_position` row; permission set `crm_sales_user`). Account list, `uf__sort` name descending:

1. Before: the switcher shows All views only, plus **Save as my view** (`01-before-switcher.png`).
2. Save as "My big accounts": `POST /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view` 201. The list opens at `/view/<id>` with the sort applied, and the row is under My views (`02`, `03`).
3. Rename to "Top accounts (mine)": `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_personal_view/<id>` 200 (`04`).
4. 📌, then a reload of the bare address opens "Top accounts (mine)", still sorted (`05`).
5. Delete: the confirm dialog, then `DELETE /api/v1/personal-views/<id>` 200. My views is empty and the bare address opens All Records with no error (`06`, `07`, `08`).

Screenshots and the request log are in the project's `issue-29635/` folder. One observation outside the card: a member with no read right on the list's object still sees **Save as my view** above the list's "You don't have access" state, because Save is gated on the `sys_personal_view` grant, not on the list object's read. I left that as it is: the card names only the refused own-views read as the hide case.

Deviations:

- The DELETE call goes through app-shell's `createAuthenticatedFetch` (the precedent is the record page's unreact door), not through `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, whose `index.ts` is busy under #29634. Seat-approved.
- The saved body carries the address's filter, sort and grouping and the reader's column order, hidden columns and density. It does not carry the search box text or quick-filter chips (neither is a `ListView` key), or column widths (no spec key).
- Personal views are left out of Manage views, which manages the object's shared views.
- The new pins are their own file, `ObjectView.personalViews-29635.test.tsx`, with a harness copied from `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594.test.tsx`. ObjectView has no shared harness file: its 88 test files each carry their own, and none imports another's (AGENTS.md ruling 6583487846).

## Verification

All at head `4c85d2e00a` (the head merges origin/main, whose 8 new commits touch no ui file):

- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 67. All 67 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. This includes `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-closing-keyword-parity` run on this body, and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files, 4977 tests).
- Touched tests on the merged head: the two new files, the four adjusted doubles, `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594`, and all of `@object-ui/i18n`. 102 files, 1509 passed.
- Before the merge: the 87 existing `ObjectView.*` files pass with this change, apart from the four doubles above. `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n` exits 0 (66 tasks), and eslint on the touched files reports 0 errors.
- No server change.
